tools.name: connect_to_cookidoo
tools.description: Authenticate with Cookidoo using the configured account.

tools.name: get_recipe_details
tools.description: Read the metadata and ingredients of an official Cookidoo recipe.

tools.name: get_custom_recipe_details
tools.description: Read a private custom recipe, including its full ingredients and preparation steps.

tools.name: get_shopping_list_ingredients
tools.signature: get_shopping_list_ingredients(recipe_id: str | None = None, include_owned: bool = false, include_additional_items: bool = true)
tools.description: Return normalized shopping-list items, optionally grouped for one recipe.

tools.name: get_meal_plan_week
tools.description: Read the rolling seven-day meal-planning window that contains the supplied ISO date.

tools.name: add_recipes_to_meal_plan
tools.signature: add_recipes_to_meal_plan(date: str, recipe_ids: str, recipe_source: str = "auto", dry_run: bool = false)
tools.description: Add one or more official or custom recipes to a date in My Week.

tools.name: remove_recipe_from_meal_plan
tools.signature: remove_recipe_from_meal_plan(date: str, recipe_id: str, recipe_source: str = "auto", dry_run: bool = false)
tools.description: Remove a recipe occurrence from a specific day.

tools.name: move_recipe_in_meal_plan
tools.signature: move_recipe_in_meal_plan(recipe_id: str, from_date: str, to_date: str, recipe_source: str = "auto", dry_run: bool = false)
tools.description: Move one recipe occurrence between two dates.

tools.name: copy_recipe_to_custom
tools.signature: copy_recipe_to_custom(recipe_id: str, servings: int = 4, dry_run: bool = false)
tools.description: Copy an official recipe into the account so its full content can be translated or adapted.

tools.name: generate_recipe_structure
tools.signature: generate_recipe_structure(name: str, ingredients: list[str], steps: list[str], servings: int = 4, prep_time: int = 30, total_time: int = 60, hints: str = "")
tools.description: Generate a valid starter payload for a custom recipe.

tools.name: validate_guided_recipe_structure
tools.description: Validate guided-cooking annotations, ranges, and the required separation of ingredients from machine actions.

tools.name: calculate_annotation_position
tools.signature: calculate_annotation_position(text: str, marker: str, occurrence: int = 1)
tools.description: Calculate the UTF-16 offset and length Cookidoo expects for an annotation marker.

tools.name: update_custom_recipe_steps
tools.signature: update_custom_recipe_steps(recipe_id: str, steps_json: str, dry_run: bool = false)
tools.description: Replace only the preparation steps of an existing custom recipe.

tools.name: update_custom_recipe_ingredients
tools.signature: update_custom_recipe_ingredients(recipe_id: str, ingredients_json: str, dry_run: bool = false)
tools.description: Replace only the ingredient list of an existing custom recipe.

tools.name: upload_custom_recipe_image
tools.signature: upload_custom_recipe_image(recipe_id: str, image_path: str, dry_run: bool = false)
tools.description: Upload a user-owned local image and assign it to a custom recipe.

tools.name: upload_custom_recipe
tools.description: Create a complete custom recipe from a validated JSON payload.
